.. py:function:: sparsify_model(model, policy, leaf_filter=eqx.is_array) :module: xtrax.sparse

Apply sparsification masks to a model, returning a new model with BCOO leaves.

This is a pure Python-side functional transform. It traverses the model pytree, applies policy.apply_mask to each leaf passing leaf_filter, and returns a new eqx.Module with BCOO weights in place of dense parameter leaves.

:type model: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:class\:\~equinox._module._module.Module`    :param model: An equinox Module to sparsify.    :type policy: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type::py:class:`~xtrax.sparse.policy.SparsePolicy`    :param policy: SparsePolicy instance defining mask and apply_mask behavior.    :type leaf_filter: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type::py:class:`~collections.abc.Callable`\ \[\[:py:data:`~typing.Any`], :py:class:`bool`]` :param leaf_filter: A callable that returns True for leaves to consider for sparsification. Default is eqx.is_array (all arrays).

:rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:class\:\~equinox._module._module.Module`` :returns: A new eqx.Module with BCOO leaves replacing 2D dense parameter leaves.

:raises RuntimeError: If called inside jax.jit (detected via Tracer check). :raises ValueError: If model already contains BCOO leaves (double sparsification).

.. py:function:: make_sparse_forward_fn(fn, sparse_model) :module: xtrax.sparse

Wrap a forward function with a sparse model closed over.

Returns a function that takes only inputs (and optional RNG), with the sparse_model already baked in as a constant.

Closing over sparse_model keeps BCOO leaves out of eqx.filter_jit’s is_array partition. BCOO is not a jax.Array — passed as an argument it would be destructured into data+indices; as a closure constant it is treated as static. This is the load-bearing mechanism for AC-6 (no-retrace guarantee).

:type fn: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:class\:\~collections.abc.Callable`\ \[\[:py:class:`~equinox._module._module.Module`, :py:data:`~typing.Any`], :py:data:`~typing.Any`]    :param fn: A callable with signature (model, inputs) -> outputs.    :type sparse_model: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type::py:class:`~equinox._module._module.Module`` :param sparse_model: The sparsified eqx.Module to close over.

:rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:class\:\~collections.abc.Callable`\ \[\[:py:data:`~typing.Any`], :py:data:`~typing.Any`]` :returns: A function with signature (inputs) -> outputs.

.. py:function:: sparse_filter_jit(fn, **kwargs) :module: xtrax.sparse

Drop-in eqx.filter_jit wrapper safe for passing BCOO-containing models.

By design, eqx.filter_jit treats all JAX/NumPy arrays as traced and all non-arrays (including BCOO) as static. Since BCOO is not a jax.Array, it is automatically held static and never destructured into .data/.indices during jit compilation. This prevents unintended retrace even when the sparsified model is passed as an argument.

This function documents the correct pattern and ensures BCOO safety without requiring equinox-specific configuration (modern equinox does not expose is_leaf parameter on filter_jit).

For maximum safety and control, prefer make_sparse_forward_fn (closure pattern) which keeps BCOO outside JAX’s tracing system entirely.

:type fn: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:class\:\~collections.abc.Callable`` :param fn: Function to jit-compile. :type **kwargs: :param **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments passed to eqx.filter_jit (e.g., donate=’all’, donate=’all-except-first’).

:rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:class\:\~collections.abc.Callable`` :returns: A jit-compiled function via eqx.filter_jit with BCOO leaves held static.

.. admonition:: Example

  >>> import equinox as eqx
  >>> import jax.numpy as jnp
  >>> @sparse_filter_jit
  ... def forward(model, x):
  ...     return model(x)
  >>> # Call with sparse model: BCOO is static, no retrace on repeated calls
